system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Configure firewall to allow SSH and HTTPS only
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Enable and start firewalld service
      systemd:
        name: firewalld
        state: started
        enabled: yes

    - name: Allow SSH service through firewall
      firewalld:
        service: ssh
        permanent: yes
        state: enabled
        immediate: yes

    - name: Allow HTTPS service through firewall
      firewalld:
        service: https
        permanent: yes
        state: enabled
        immediate: yes

    - name: Set default zone to drop (deny all incoming by default)
      firewalld:
        zone: drop
        state: enabled
        permanent: yes
        immediate: yes
        default_zone: yes

    - name: Ensure SSH port is explicitly allowed in drop zone
      firewalld:
        port: 22/tcp
        zone: drop
        permanent: yes
        state: enabled
        immediate: yes

    - name: Ensure HTTPS port is explicitly allowed in drop zone
      firewalld:
        port: 443/tcp
        zone: drop
        permanent: yes
        state: enabled
        immediate: yes

    - name: Reload firewalld to apply all changes
      command: firewall-cmd --reload
      changed_when: false
